primaryChecks.text: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 2:22 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
primaryChecks.nextContext: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:9 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:10 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
primaryChecks.nextContext: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:16 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.previousContext: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.nextContext: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:80 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
primaryChecks.nextContext: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 26:31 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
primaryChecks.previousContext: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
primaryChecks.nextContext: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 27:21 はGileadを地理的な対象として明記する。
